title: Payments Operations Q&A: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Lapses and the Parking Tow Notice Fee
content:
**Q. How does a lapsed AutoPay authorization bear on the tow notice fee of a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement?**

An AutoPay relief is taken off the fee, read from the agreement's Bluegate AutoPay Authorization: **$5.00** where the authorization stands suspended and one or more of its drafts was declined for an expired card in the last 3 months; **$2.00** where it stands suspended with no such decline in that time; nothing where it is not suspended. The relief is taken off after the fee level has been multiplied by anything it is multiplied by; the fee is never below zero and is rounded to the cent.

**Q. What is the window?** A window of the last 3 months covers entries dated less than 3 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. Drafts are placed in it by their draft date.

**Q. Which records are read?** The Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on this parking agreement: its status (suspended or not) and its drafts' results (declined for an expired card) and draft dates.

**Q. Hypothetical cases?**

| Authorization | Expired-card decline in last 3 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| Suspended | Yes | $5.00 |
| Suspended | No (declines for other reasons only, or none) | $2.00 |
| Active | Yes | nothing |
| None on the agreement | — | nothing |

**Q. Can the relief take the fee below zero?** No; the fee is never below zero.
